widgets.name: Pinned command
widgets.description: Runs a saved command and shows how it last exited

tutorial.title: Tabs keep running
tutorial.body: A terminal tab stays alive until you close it. Start a long job, switch panels or close the window, and it keeps going.

tutorial.title: Copy and paste with a right click
tutorial.body: No hidden shortcuts to memorize: right click inside a tab to copy and paste.

tutorial.title: Pick up on another computer
tutorial.body: Sessions live in the daemon, so a tab you start on one computer can be opened from any other computer you've connected.

tutorial.title: Save the commands you repeat
tutorial.body: Save a command once and launch it from the tab bar, or pin it to Home to run it in one click.

screenshots.alt: Saved commands from the tab bar
